en.title: Garden of Eden
en.description:
The garden of EDEN May 25, 2024 (ASIN:B0D57HM21F)
          This paper is a collection of original images, and the fragments of the memories that I lived in the Golden State of California, 15 years ago. There are more than 600 photographs, sketches, and projects I've had the courage to dream of, and at the end, I put them into practice.
